name: megascenes-avatar
description: Create avatars and profile pictures from a description, in styles from 3D cartoon to anime and flat illustration.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the look you want and get an avatar: a 3D cartoon, an anime portrait, a flat illustration or a pixel character for your profile.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the avatar in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The avatar opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For social profiles, gaming handles and team pages.

Limitations: avatars from a description, not from a photo; it does not make likenesses of real people. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Return the avatar in the chat
defaultPrompt: A 3D cartoon avatar of a girl with curly red hair and glasses
An anime style avatar of a calm samurai with a cat
A flat illustration avatar of a bearded hiker in a yellow beanie

positive.prompt: A 3D cartoon avatar of a girl with curly red hair and round glasses. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one avatar needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: An anime style avatar of a calm samurai holding a cat. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one avatar needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make an avatar here?
positive.expected_behavior: The avatar models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A flat illustration avatar of a bearded hiker in a yellow beanie. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my avatar on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my avatar to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
